5095393383637.sourceDescription:
This 7ft artificial Christmas tree features a realistic full spruce design with densely packed tips that recreate the natural charm of authentic evergreen branches. The green plastic construction ensures a lifelike appearance, providing a rich festive atmosphere during the holiday season without the mess of real needles falling on your floor.

With 2942 densely packed tips across its 119cm width, this tree offers impressive fullness far exceeding standard models with fewer tips. The abundant foliage creates a beautiful silhouette and a substantial presence in any room, ensuring your decoration looks lush and complete from every angle throughout the celebrations.

Assembly is quick and tool-free thanks to the simple sections design with hinged and moulded branches requiring minimal shaping. You can set up this Xmas tree in approximately 35-40 minutes, saving valuable time so you can focus on family festivities rather than struggling with complex setup procedures.

Crafted with flame-retardant properties, each branch is tested for safety, allowing you to place the tree near fireplaces or warm lights without concern. This feature ensures safe enjoyment year after year, giving you peace of mind while basking in the warm glow of your festive decorations securely.

The reinforced metal base provides stability, keeping the 210cm tall tree upright and secure against accidental bumps or pets moving around it. Additionally, the foldable stand design allows for incredibly easy storage once the festivities are over, making it convenient to pack away neatly until next year's holiday season.
Realistic full spruce design with 2942 densely packed tips for a lush, authentic festive appearance.
Flame-retardant branches tested for safety, allowing secure placement near fireplaces and warm lights.
Quick tool-free assembly in approximately 35-40 minutes thanks to simple sections and hinged branches.
Reinforced metal base provides stability while the foldable stand allows for convenient storage after use.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Hinged
Assembly required

A hanging loop above the decorative cap provides a way to position the bauble on a suitable tree branch or include it in a wreath or garland arrangement. The 10cm size creates a visible accent among foliage, ribbons and other hanging ornaments, while the green finish helps you coordinate a consistent seasonal colour scheme. Use the matching pieces to repeat the design across the tree, or combine with your own plain and patterned decorations for a varied display. These Christmas tree ornaments also work in indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery, winter wedding decorations and festive party displays. This option contains 3 baubles, with the same thread covering and sequin-band design on each piece. Display the band facing forward so its sequin detail remains visible between branches.
Thread Ball Baubles: Includes 3 matching 10cm green Christmas tree baubles, with a thread-wrapped surface and a gold sequin band around the middle. The round ornaments add colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, wreaths and garlands, with the same finish on each selected piece.
Sequin Band Detail: The gold band contrasts with the green thread covering, combining a textured finish with reflective sequin detail. Place these decorative Christmas balls among foliage and ribbons to add a different surface beside plain baubles in your seasonal arrangement.
Hanging Tree Ornaments: A loop above the decorative cap provides a hanging point for each bauble. Position the 10cm ornaments on suitable branches or incorporate them into a wreath or garland, spacing them between other decorations so the thread texture and sequin band remain visible.
Coordinated Christmas Decor: Use the green colour to build a consistent tree theme, or combine the baubles with contrasting ornaments and ribbon. The round shape suits traditional Christmas decorations, winter wedding displays and festive party arrangements around the home.
Display And Pack Contents: Includes 3 matching decorative balls for a repeated accent, each measuring 10cm. Add to indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery or a decorated tree, then coordinate with your own bows, foliage and seasonal accessories for a display throughout the festive season.

5056141080437.sourceDescription:
The pack contains 16 decorative bloody body parts cut-outs across two garlands. The themed cut-outs create a Halloween hanging display that can be arranged across a wall, doorway or party backdrop, carrying the bloody body parts motif along the decorated area. The cardboard shapes depict blood-effect hands and feet for a staged horror scene. The printed shapes form the visual theme of the garland, giving the hanging decoration its horror appearance. Arrange them facing the viewing area so the individual designs remain visible. Use the supplied string to display the cut-outs as a garland across your chosen scene. Position the ends to suit the space and let the shapes hang beneath the line, creating a horizontal decoration above a table, doorway or themed party photograph area. Add the garland to a wall display or hang it around an interior doorway or window to extend your Halloween theme. 8635560241437.baseName: 8 Pack Christmas Stocking Cap Hanging Ornaments, 8 cm Acrylic Santa Decorations, Red and White
8635560241437.variantName: 8 Pack Christmas Stocking Cap Hanging Ornaments, 8 cm Acrylic Santa Decorations, Red and White
8635560241437.sourceDescription:
Add a bit of humour to a tree, a garland or a gift bag with this set of eight small hanging ornaments, each shaped like a floppy Santa stocking cap with a face peering out.

The ornaments are cut from a clear acrylic sheet with a smooth polished edge and printed in red and white, so they catch the tree lights along the edge and look crisp rather than flimsy. Each one is about 8 cm high, which is the right scale for a busy tree: large enough to be noticed, small enough not to crowd the baubles.

Because they are flat and light, they hang well from tight branches, garland wire, a tabletop tree or a length of ribbon across a window. Thread them on a hook or a piece of cotton and they will hang straight rather than tipping to one side, and they will not weigh down a delicate branch.

Eight in a pack is enough to make a theme across one tree, to fill a small tree completely, or to tie one to each place setting, gift bag or bottle at a Christmas table. They also make a simple party favour for a children's class or a family gathering, since the design appeals to children without being childish.

Being acrylic rather than card, the ornaments survive being dropped, knocked and packed away, and they wipe clean with a damp cloth. Store them in a small box so the printed faces do not rub against sharp decorations.

The printed faces are sealed under the acrylic, so the design does not rub off in a box of decorations. Because the ornaments are flat, they can be posted in a card or slipped into a gift bag without extra padding. Eight in a pack also suits a nursery or a classroom tree, where decorations need to be light and unbreakable. Store them with the printed sides facing each other to avoid scuffing.

One pack contains eight stocking cap ornaments in a matching design.

8 cm Hanging Size: A useful scale for a busy tree, big enough to be noticed among the baubles but small enough not to crowd the branches
Light and Flat: Hangs straight from tight branches, garland wire and ribbons without tipping or weighing down delicate twigs
Fun Gift and Favour: The puzzled face design appeals to children, making the pack an easy party favour, class gift or stocking filler

5096042277437.baseName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Gold baubles and silver berries for hanging on a door or wall, Green and gold, 50 cm
5096042277437.variantName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Gold baubles and silver berries for hanging on a door or wall, Green and gold, 50 cm
5096042277437.sourceDescription:
Gold baubles and olive leaves stand out amongst bright green pine-style branches. Silver berries, cones and leaf-shaped ribbon break up the metallic finish, giving the 50 cm arrangement a layered, vintage-inspired look.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Fine pine-style sprigs lend themselves to a simple woodland scheme. A plain background keeps the outline of the needles visible, especially where the foliage spreads towards the edge of the decoration.

Curved bauble surfaces reflect the colours immediately around them. Try hanging the wreath where it catches a little daylight and leave space in front of the decorations to show the different surfaces. A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms. Choose one shade from your tree decorations for the hallway and repeat it in a small accent beside the wreath, letting the greenery carry the rest of the scheme.

From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail. The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together. If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them.
Festive gold baubles and silver berries create a vintage-inspired look on green pine-style branches.
Complete one-piece design makes hanging easy in entrances or on walls without taking up floor space.
Layered details including olive leaves, cones and leaf-shaped ribbon add depth to the woodland theme.
Compact 50 cm size is ideal for small spaces, hallways and doorways where a full tree is not possible.

5058194855437.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal focal point to your home decor.
Reusable fabric design allows for easy care and storage between holiday seasons.
Compact single set format fits easily into smaller spaces without cluttering displays.
Versatile decoration suitable for coordinating with existing colour schemes and textures.
Comes with 1x Christmas Wreath

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Double Sided Design
The two sided design gives you a choice of usable surfaces or presentation. Turn the item to the side that suits the intended arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.
